bio_text: Estelle is the CEO and founder of Lucé Robotics, a European humanoid robotics company building solutions for labor-intensive industries. She advocates for Europe developing independent robotics capabilities and sees humanoid robots as critical to solving labor shortages across manufacturing and service sectors.
